description: SoorgaAI Assessment Focus Areas — 7 capability domains measured across all industries

focusAreas.name: AI Strategy & Vision
focusAreas.description: The degree to which the organization has a clear, funded, and socialized AI strategy aligned with business objectives.
focusAreas.executiveFocus: Does your organization have a clear AI strategy with executive buy-in and dedicated budget?
keyCapabilities: Documented AI vision and multi-year roadmap
Dedicated AI investment budget (not just IT budget)
AI strategy reviewed and updated at least annually
AI KPIs tracked at executive and board level
Clear ownership of AI transformation at C-suite
probeAreas: Alignment between AI strategy and business goals

focusAreas.name: Leadership & Culture
focusAreas.description: The level of AI literacy, advocacy, and cultural readiness across leadership and the broader workforce.
focusAreas.executiveFocus: Do your leaders champion AI transformation, and is your culture ready to work alongside AI?
keyCapabilities: C-suite champions AI with visible actions (not just words)
Leaders understand AI capabilities and limitations
Organization has a growth mindset toward AI-driven change
AI successes and failures are celebrated as learning opportunities
Cross-functional AI collaboration is rewarded
probeAreas: Change management and AI adoption culture

focusAreas.name: AI Use Cases & Applications
focusAreas.description: The breadth, maturity, and business impact of AI applications currently in use or development.
focusAreas.executiveFocus: Are you deploying AI where it creates the most business value, and can you demonstrate ROI?
keyCapabilities: Structured process for identifying and prioritizing AI use cases
AI use cases in production delivering measurable business outcomes
Portfolio spans multiple functions (not just IT or R&D)
Clear ROI measurement framework for AI investments
Mechanism for scaling successful pilots enterprise-wide
probeAreas: Use case identification and prioritization process
Number and maturity of AI use cases in production
Business value delivered and ROI demonstrated

focusAreas.name: Data Readiness
focusAreas.description: The quality, accessibility, and governance of data assets that power AI systems.
focusAreas.executiveFocus: Is your data organized, governed, and accessible enough to train and run AI systems reliably?
keyCapabilities: Centralized and accessible data platform
Data quality standards and monitoring in place
Data governance and ownership clearly defined
Real-time or near-real-time data pipelines for key processes
Data privacy and compliance frameworks active
probeAreas: Volume and variety of usable training data

focusAreas.name: Technology & Infrastructure
focusAreas.description: The maturity of AI-enabling technology: cloud, MLOps, compute, and integration capabilities.
focusAreas.executiveFocus: Does your technology stack enable rapid AI development, deployment, and scaling?
keyCapabilities: Cloud-native infrastructure supporting AI workloads
MLOps platform for model development and deployment
Scalable compute (GPU/TPU access as needed)
API-first integration enabling AI across systems
Model monitoring and observability in production
probeAreas: AI tooling standardization and developer experience

focusAreas.name: Skills & Workforce
focusAreas.description: The depth and breadth of AI talent, skills development programs, and workforce readiness.
focusAreas.executiveFocus: Do you have the AI talent to execute your strategy, and are you building capabilities for the future?
keyCapabilities: Dedicated AI/ML team with senior capability
Formal AI upskilling programs for the broader workforce
Clear AI talent acquisition and retention strategy
AI literacy programs for non-technical staff
Partnerships with universities or specialized AI firms
probeAreas: AI talent depth and technical capability

focusAreas.name: Governance, Ethics & Security
focusAreas.description: The frameworks, policies, and practices ensuring AI is deployed responsibly, securely, and compliantly.
focusAreas.executiveFocus: Do you have the guardrails to deploy AI responsibly and protect your organization from AI-related risks?
keyCapabilities: AI ethics principles and responsible AI framework
AI risk assessment process before deployment
Model explainability and transparency standards
Regulatory compliance for AI in your industry
AI security practices including adversarial testing
probeAreas: AI ethics framework and responsible AI policies
